test_title: PYST 41: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question:
Solve the following equation

sec²theta(sqrt{1-sin²theta})= _______.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put **θ = 0°** as a test value.

Expression: sec²0°(√(1 − sin²0°))

⇒ 1² × (√(1 − 0)) = 1 × 1 = 1.

Check options at 0°: (1) tan 0° = 0, (2) cosec 0° = undefined, (3) sec 0° = 1, (4) 1. Since (3) and (4) both give 1, try **θ = 60°**.

⇒ sec²60° × cos 60° = 4 × (1/2) = 2. Only sec 60° = 2.

**∴ The correct answer is sec θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** sec²θ(√(1 − sin²θ))

**Formula Used:**

1) sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 ⇒ cos²θ = 1 − sin²θ

2) sec θ = 1/cos θ

**Calculations:**

⇒ sec²θ × √(cos²θ)

⇒ sec²θ × cos θ

⇒ (1/cos²θ) × cos θ

⇒ 1/cos θ

⇒ sec θ

**∴ The correct answer is sec θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Standard Pythagorean identities include sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Relations

Reciprocal pairs are (sin θ, cosec θ), (cos θ, sec θ), and (tan θ, cot θ). Their product is always 1.</p
